messages.content: when will miraculous ladybug season 2 episode 12 come out

message.content:
**Miraculous Ladybug Season 2, Episode 12** originally aired on **May 13, 2018** according to Rotten Tomatoes, which lists it as season 2, episode 12 with that release date.[1]

There is some **episode-numbering confusion** in available sources: IMDb lists **“Gorizilla”** as season 2, episode 12 with a date of **March 30, 2018**, while the Miraculous Ladybug site lists **“The Sapotis”** as episode 12.[3][5][8] If you mean the episode most commonly labeled **Season 2, Episode 12** on TV listings, the best answer is **May 13, 2018**.[1]

If you want, I can also help identify the episode by **title** or by the **region/platform** you’re using, since release dates varied by country.[4]
